Cleaning services for homes and businesses in Santa Maria and beyond

One company for the office, the house, the rental and the windows. Tell us what you need and we will put together a plan and a price that fits.

Commercial

Janitorial and office cleaning

Your customers and employees notice a clean building. We provide janitorial services for offices, retail stores, medical and professional offices, and commercial buildings in Santa Maria, Orcutt, San Luis Obispo and the surrounding area.

We work nights, weekends or around your business hours, so cleaning never gets in the way. You get a consistent crew, a set checklist and a direct line to the owner if anything needs attention.

  • Restrooms cleaned and restocked
  • Break rooms and kitchens
  • Trash and recycling removal
  • Vacuuming and mopping
  • Desks, doors and high touch areas
  • Nightly, weekly or custom schedules
Ask for a commercial cleaning quote
Residential

House cleaning and maid service

Come home to a clean house without giving up your weekend. Our maid service covers weekly, bi-weekly and monthly house cleaning, plus one time deep cleaning when your home needs a reset before guests, holidays or a special event.

We clean the way you would if you had the time: kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas and the details that usually get skipped, like baseboards, light fixtures and range hoods.

  • Weekly and bi-weekly cleaning
  • Deep cleaning
  • Kitchens and appliances
  • Bathrooms, tubs and showers
  • Dusting and floors
  • Laundry and dishes on request
Get a house cleaning quote
Tenants, landlords & realtors

Move in and move out cleaning

Moving is stressful enough. Our move out cleaning helps tenants get their deposit back, and our move in cleaning gives you a fresh start before the boxes come in. We also work with landlords, property managers and real estate agents who need a unit ready to show or rent fast.

An empty home gets a top to bottom cleaning, including the spots most people forget.

  • Inside oven and refrigerator
  • Cabinets and drawers inside and out
  • Bathrooms scrubbed and disinfected
  • Baseboards, doors and switches
  • Window sills and tracks
  • Floors vacuumed and mopped
Book a move out cleaning
Exterior

Window cleaning and pressure washing

Clean windows let in more light and make a home or storefront look cared for. We clean interior and exterior windows, frames, screens and tracks for homes, offices and retail buildings, using water fed poles for high glass.

Our pressure washing removes dirt, grime, gum and stains from sidewalks, driveways, patios, entryways and building exteriors. We also clear debris from roofs and gutters and rinse solar panels so they keep working at their best.

  • Residential window cleaning
  • Storefront and office windows
  • Screens, frames and tracks
  • Driveways and walkways
  • Patios and building exteriors
  • Gutters and solar panels

Common questions

Quick answers about our cleaning services. Don't see your question? Call us at (805) 922-6500.

What cleaning services does J&E offer in Santa Maria?

We offer janitorial and commercial cleaning, house cleaning and maid service, move in and move out cleaning, window cleaning, pressure washing, carpet cleaning, floor stripping and waxing, and new construction cleaning in Santa Maria and across the Central Coast.

Are you licensed, bonded and insured?

Yes. J & E Cleaning Services, Inc. is fully licensed, bonded and insured, and we hold an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.

How much does house cleaning cost in Santa Maria?

The price depends on the size of your home, its current condition and how often you want us to come. Quotes are always free. Call us or send a message below and we will give you a clear price with no surprises.

What is included in a move out cleaning?

We clean inside the oven and refrigerator, cabinets and drawers inside and out, bathrooms top to bottom, baseboards, doors, light switches, window sills and tracks, and all floors. It is designed to help tenants get their deposit back and help landlords get the unit ready to rent.

Do you clean offices and commercial buildings?

Yes. We clean offices, stores, medical and professional offices, and commercial buildings on nightly, weekly or custom schedules. That includes restrooms, break rooms, trash removal, floors and high touch surfaces.

How often can I schedule a cleaning?

You can book daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or one time cleaning. Many homeowners start with a deep cleaning and then move to a bi-weekly schedule.

Do you do window cleaning and pressure washing?

Yes. We clean interior and exterior windows for homes and businesses, and we pressure wash walkways, patios, driveways, storefronts and building exteriors throughout Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties.

Which cities do you serve?

Santa Maria, Orcutt, Nipomo, Guadalupe, Los Alamos, Solvang, Buellton, Santa Ynez, San Luis Obispo, Pismo Beach, Shell Beach, Grover Beach, Oceano and Avila Beach.
